restaurantName: La Poste et Hôtel La Reconce
bio: The Restaurant de la Poste is run by a chef who hails from the village, ably assisted by his wife. His ambition is clear: to regale diners with modern dishes that celebrate good local produce – braised Charolais beef shank wrapped in celeriac, with pot-au-feu bouillon and wasabi, is a good example. Well-kept rooms, should you wish to stay over....
pageTitle: La Poste et Hôtel La Reconce
